Mārasutta About Māra

“Mārasenappamaddanaṁ vo, bhikkhave, maggaṁ desessāmi; “Mendicants, I will teach you a path for crushing Māra’s army. taṁ suṇātha. Listen …

Katamo ca, bhikkhave, mārasenappamaddano maggo? And what is that path? Yadidaṁ— satta bojjhaṅgā. It is the seven awakening factors. Katame satta? What seven? Satisambojjhaṅgo …pe… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo—The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity. ayaṁ kho, bhikkhave, mārasenappamaddano maggo”ti. This is the path for crushing Māra’s army.”

Tatiyaṁ.
